catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue read class fits the raw pressure of this sensor: cap.measure.pressure.v1 fixes the output unit to Pa while no line of the clone states the engineering unit, and cap.sensing.read.v1 needs a values object and an input that the single proven Signal.get cannot build without a fake-only method.
catalogue_requests.summary: Read the raw pressure value of a bact2 VacuumSensor

notes:
PASS on the fake backend. The package is a config-only OphydDriver for the card entry symbol bact2.ophyd.devices.raw.vacuum:VacuumSensor at the pinned commit 1521bf0323aa1ad77c8a00d9664e4b6746157432. It serves the two direct Components pressure (:rdPress) and quality (:stMeasQuality) as fresh Signal.get(use_monitor=False) reads and adds the observational extension x-cap.tmsangohan.vacuum_reading.v1 (the same fresh pressure.get); catalogue_requests records why no catalogue class fits. No line of the clone states a unit or a range, so the fields carry no unit and no Limit is declared; there is no writable input. Safety: the sensor has no actuator and the whole VacuumSensor class (vacuum.py:3-5) defines no stop; the R1 e-stop binding calls the inherited ophyd Device.stop, which is outside the pinned clone, so the endpoint latch is the protection this package can provide and no physical stop is claimed. The fake's stop only counts calls. Warnings left: G7.MAYBE_ABSENT ('stop' is inherited from the external ophyd Device base, so it is not in the class surface) and G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (no limit on an actuating capability; every other CL3 test passed). The fake is F0, analytic test data (pressure 1.0e-7 and quality 1.0 are placeholders), not a recording. NOT COVERED: the PV engineering unit and the meaning of the quality bits, and the implementation and effect of the inherited Device.stop; the package never connected to an IOC and no hardware run was made. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by is null); fake evidence is contract_checked only. Licence: the card and driver.lock.json say NOASSERTION while setup.py:21 says GPL, so publication needs the owner's decision (publish_review required).

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review confirmed the selected VacuumSensor has only two EpicsSignalRO Components, no writable PVs and no in-clone native stop; risk remains the card floor R1. Corrected the full-class Fact and its import-inclusive citation in driver.py, documented the excluded PowerConverter, Steerer and BPMStorageRing entries in facts.md, regenerated reference.json and REFERENCE.md, and refreshed check-report.json. The fake gate, package tests and strict collector pass with the disclosed inherited-stop and non-actuating SAFE-014 notes. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Scope is the read-only VacuumSensor, not the writable power-converter/steerer classes in the same repository. Pressure and quality have no source-backed unit/range/quality-bit meaning and remain raw observations. The inherited ophyd Device.stop implementation is outside the pin; completion does not establish a physical change, and the fake stop only counts calls. Publication still requires the owner's licence decision: card/lock are NOASSERTION, setup.py:21 says GPL without a version, and task.publish_review is required. No IOC, upstream module or hardware was run; evidence remains fake contract checks and reviewed_by remains null.
